description: This file defines the ViewsEntitySchemaSubscriber class in Drupal, which reacts to entity type changes to update view configurations accordingly. It handles renaming, addition, and removal of entity tables and revision support, and updates views to reflect schema changes.

classes.name: ViewsEntitySchemaSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal class that listens to entity type changes to update view configurations accordingly, handling schema renames, additions, and removals.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity type manager and logger.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to.

methods.name: onEntityTypeUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to entity types, updating views based on schema changes.

methods.name: onEntityTypeDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of entity types, disabling views that depend on their tables.

methods.name: processHandlers
methods.description: Applies a processing function to all handlers of all views.

methods.name: baseTableRename
methods.description: Updates views when a base table is renamed.

methods.name: dataTableRename
methods.description: Updates views when a data table is renamed.

methods.name: dataTableAddition
methods.description: Updates views when a new data table is added.

methods.name: dataTableRemoval
methods.description: Updates views when a data table is removed.

methods.name: revisionRemoval
methods.description: Disables views when revision support is removed from an entity type.
